decision: Deletion of 2 lap times (2:02.026, 1:22.676), as per Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and item 11.4 a) of the Race Director's Notes version 3.
event_name: Date 07 September 2019 Time 14:43 2019 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 20 left the track at Turn 11, rejoined and gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Ch IV, Art 2 c) of the FIA International Sporting Code and Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Deletion of 2 lap times (2:02.026, 1:22.676), as per Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and item 11.4 a) of the Race Director's Notes version 3.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and received timing information from the Race Director. The car left the track during practice 3, rejoined and gained a lasting advantage.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and item 11
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 20 Track Limits
